description: Native 4th-pane plumbing for the Pi side panel in Thunderbird's about:3pane. Manipulates only Thunderbird's native UI; all ACP/session/mail logic lives in the normal extension background.

functions.name: open
functions.description: Install the Pi pane into the about:3pane of the given mail tab. No-op if already open. Rejects if the tab is not a mail 3-pane tab.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: WebExtension tab id of the mail 3-pane tab.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Remove the Pi pane from the given mail tab. No-op if not open.

functions.name: toggle
functions.description: Open the Pi pane if closed, close it if open.

functions.name: setWidth
functions.description: Set the width of the Pi pane in CSS pixels for the given mail tab.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width in px (clamped to a minimum of 180).

functions.name: getState
functions.description: Return the open/width state of the Pi pane for the given mail tab.
